# `Browser.Speech.Internals`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Speech.Internals — the low-level speech synthesis port surface:
the closed outbound/inbound ADTs and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js` request/subscribe
wiring the high-level `Ipe.Browser.Speech` layer wraps.

Importing this submodule discloses the same `js-port:speech` axis as the
top-level module (the disclosure is keyed on the `Ipe.Browser.Speech` path
prefix), so the raw port surface cannot be reached undisclosed.

## `Options`

Synthesis options. All fields are clamped by the browser to its own
supported range; out-of-range values are silently normalised by the browser
and do not cause an error.

  * `rate` — speaking rate in the range [0.1, 10.0]; 1.0 is normal speed.
  * `pitch` — voice pitch in [0.0, 2.0]; 1.0 is normal pitch.
  * `volume` — output volume in [0.0, 1.0]; 1.0 is full volume.
  * `lang` — BCP-47 language tag (e.g. `"en-US"`); an empty string means
    the browser chooses its default voice.

## `defaultOptions`

```ipe
defaultOptions : Options
```

Sensible defaults: normal rate, pitch, and volume; browser-default language.

## `JsCmd`

The closed OUTBOUND port type. The entire outbound surface is a single
auditable object.

  * `Speak { text, options }` — synthesise `text` with the given options; a
    single inbound `JsMsg` arrives when synthesis completes or fails.
  * `Cancel` — cancel any queued or in-progress utterance. The browser
    calls `speechSynthesis.cancel()`. No inbound reply is sent for a cancel.

## `JsMsg`

The NARROW closed INBOUND port type — NOT the app's internal `Msg`. Every
variant the browser can push is enumerated, so the fold in the high-level
layer is EXHAUSTIVE and a denial or an absent API can never be silently
dropped: it becomes a typed `Err`.

  * `Spoken` — synthesis completed without error.
  * `Unavailable` — the `speechSynthesis` API is absent in this context.
  * `Failed` — the browser fired an error event (e.g. interrupted, cancelled
    by a subsequent call, or a network error on a remote voice).

## `request`

```ipe
request : JsCmd -> Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`request cmd` — hand a closed outbound `JsCmd` to the raw port transport.
The served first-party JS sink reaches `speechSynthesis.speak`; a completion
or error arrives inbound as a `JsMsg`.

## `requestOne`

```ipe
requestOne : JsCmd -> Task Error JsMsg
```

`requestOne cmd` — correlated one-shot `JsCmd` → `Task Error JsMsg`.
Routes through `Js.request` with the `inbound` decoder so the correlated
reply is decoded fail-closed by the same gate the `subscribe` path uses.

## `subscribe`

```ipe
subscribe : (JsMsg -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`subscribe toMsg` — the inbound subscription over the fail-closed seal
decoder. `inbound` IS the security gate; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole.

## `inbound`

```ipe
inbound : Decode.Decoder JsMsg
```

The total, fail-closed decoder for a `JsMsg` frame of this capability.

It first requires the frame's `tag` to be `portTag`, so a frame of another
capability, or an untagged one, fails closed; the rest decodes as `inboundBody`.
